notes.title: Update for November 9, 2024
notes.content:
[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the selected level value wouldn't reset when a custom level began.
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the selected level value wouldn't reset when a custom level began.

notes.title: Update for October 26, 2024
notes.content:
[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a new Halloween theme.
[*]Fixed the issue with music only playing once if there was one song in the Music folder with "Custom Songs Only" enabled.
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed the issue with music only playing once if there was one song in the Music folder with "Custom Songs Only" enabled.

notes.title: Update for September 25, 2024
notes.content:
[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added an option to put the music text on the top-left.
[*]Added another toggle for something after beating the game.
[*]New icon for the executable file.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*]Added an option to put the music text on the top-left.

notes.title: Update for September 25, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added an Achievement.
[*]Controller Players can now use the D-Pad to move.
[*]Fixed an exploit with the Raging Cacti challenge.
[/list]

tags.feature: Controller Players can now use the D-Pad to move.

tags.bug: Fixed an exploit with the Raging Cacti challenge.

notes.title: Bug Fixes for September 24, 2024
notes.content:
[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*]The "Use W and S to scroll" prompt no longer appears when using a controller.
[*]Added an Achievement.
[*]Fixed the aspect ratio on Workshop Item Previews.
[/list]
